items.title: Crash with school bus on Signal Mountain reportedly leaves 1 driver dead
items.summary: A crash with a school bus on Signal Mountain left a driver dead Tuesday morning, according to a report from Local 3 News. The crash, reportedly a head-on collision between a Sequatchie County school bus and a white sedan, closed a portion of Taft Highway for several hours Tuesday
